info.name: Restaurant - Order APIs
info.description: Creates its own category, products and two customers (random suffix). There is no delete-order API, so the orders and the three ordered products stay in the database (see the cleanup SQL).

item.name: 10 - USER A creates an order (2 products)

exec: pm.test("two products with name and price", () => { pm.expect(j.data.products.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.data.products.map(p => p.productId)).to.eql([Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("p1Id")), Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("p2Id"))]); pm.expect(j.data.products[0].price).to.eql(9.5); });
const d = new Date(j.data.createdDate.substring(0, 10) + "T00:00:00Z"); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); pm.collectionVariables.set("tomorrow", d.toISOString().substring(0, 10));

exec: pm.test("message", () => pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Authentication is required to access this resource"));
pm.test("ordered by id ASC", () => { const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

pm.test("only the orders of user A", () => { pm.expect(j.data.content.every(o => o.username === pm.collectionVariables.get("userA"))).to.eql(true); const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderA1Id"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderA2Id"))); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderB1Id"))); });
pm.test("only the orders of user B", () => pm.expect(j.data.content.every(o => o.username === pm.collectionVariables.get("userB"))).to.eql(true));

pm.test("message", () => pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Page number must be 1 or greater"));
pm.test("message", () => pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Page size must be between 1 and 50"));

S01 - No criteria returns every order (paginated)

exec: pm.test("ordered by id ASC", () => { const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });
pm.test("every order has createdBy = the searched user", () => pm.expect(j.data.content.every(o => o.createdBy === pm.collectionVariables.get("userA"))).to.eql(true));

pm.test("contains the expected orders", () => { const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderA1Id"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderA2Id"))); });
pm.test("does not contain other orders", () => { const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("orderB1Id"))); });
pm.test("ordered by id ASC", () => { const ids = j.data.content.map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });
